scientific_integrity: All unbounded-index equivalences use a uniform coordinate-matching proof. Distinctions for the six smallest index sizes are derived from exhaustive exact finite orbit-refinement and confirmed with concrete-state enumeration; computations alone are not extrapolated to infinite families. Historical priority is qualified and independent validation is absent. Earliest online source date follows the author-preprint header dated 2012-03-18; the arXiv version has a separately verified 2012-05-04 first-posting date.
scientific_limitations: Only the trivial-group matrix-unit Brandt family, named zero, and ternary relational multiplication in counting-free three-variable logic. The finite rank-four separation has an exact exhaustive orbit-game certificate, not a short explicit separator. No functional-semigroup, counting-logic, or general Brandt classification is asserted.
title: Six \(\mathrm{FO}^{3}\) theories of finite Brandt matrix-unit semigroups
